narrativeProgression.description: Craig Ferguson welcomes actress Jane Leeves to the show. They joke about their on-screen kiss in 'Hot in Cleveland'. Jane Leeves discusses her summer vacation in England, her family's love for surfing, and her aversion to water sports. She talks about the live episode of 'Hot in Cleveland' and the guest stars they had. The conversation then shifts to Jane Leeves' experience in Scotland and her love for haggis. Craig Ferguson tries to make a joke about haggis, which falls flat. They end the interview with an awkward pause.
